newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: FCC in Indonesian property joint venture.
newsitem.headline: FCC in Indonesian property joint venture.

text.p: Property group First Capital Corp Ltd (FCC) said on Wednesday it had entered into a joint venture with four Indonesian companies to develop commercial and residential complexes in central Jakarta.
FCC's partners are P.T. Unggul Indah Corp (PT UIC), P.T. Unggul Indah Investama (UII), P.T. Salim Chemicals Corpora (Salim) and P.T. Ekaprana Graha Adhika (Ekaprana).
FCC will acquire 40 percent in the joint venture company, P.T. Wiranusa Grahatama.
UII, a wholly-owned subsidiary of PT UIC, Salim and Ekaprana would hold 40.3 percent, 11.8 percent and 7.9 percent respectively in Wiranusa.
FCC said UII's contribution of its stake in the joint venture is by way of injecting PT UIC's land parcels amounting to 17,150 sqm at a land cost of US$2,600 psm.

FCC said the cost of its interest in the joint venture will be based on the net tangible assets of the Wiranusa. The acquisition cost will be paid progressively through share capital and mandatory convertible bonds issued by Wiranusa over three and a half years or earlier, it said.
